Title: Vice President, Infrastructure Services & Information Security
Description:
**Why We Are - Who We Are:** About FFF Enterprises
  
What We Do - https://www.fffenterprises.com/company/what-we-do.html
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Vice President, Infrastructure Services & Information Security leads the strategy, engineering, delivery, and operation of enterprise infrastructure services and information security across FFF Enterprises and its affiliated businesses. The position is accountable for the reliability, scalability, resilience, and security of technology platforms and services, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, networks and communications, digital workplace and end-user services, distribution center technology, cybersecurity operations, and enterprise information protection.
  
The role establishes and executes integrated infrastructure and information security roadmaps, operating standards, service ownership models, security controls, and continuous improvement priorities aligned with enterprise technology strategy, business requirements, and regulatory obligations. Responsibilities include technology service delivery, operational resilience, information security governance, cyber risk management, vulnerability and third-party security oversight, incident preparedness and response, and secure adoption of emerging technologies.
  
Through leadership of multidisciplinary technical teams and collaboration with business and technology stakeholders, the Vice President strengthens service reliability, security effectiveness, operational performance, and organizational capabilities. The position provides informed recommendations to executive leadership regarding technology investments, material risks, operational priorities, and performance outcomes while supporting established escalation, risk acceptance, and independent assurance processes.
  
  
Essential Functions and Duties
  
Enterprise Technology & Security Strategy, Governance & Roadmaps:
  

* Lead integrated infrastructure services and information security planning, establishing multi-year roadmaps aligned with enterprise technology strategy, business growth, critical service needs, and applicable security requirements.
* Define organizational design, service ownership, roles, decision rights, and escalation practices across infrastructure engineering, operations, cybersecurity, security governance, and supporting vendors.
* Establish common planning and review cadences for service performance, security posture, investment decisions, remediation priorities, material incidents, and continuous improvement.
* Advise executive leadership on technology modernization, emerging threats, resilience, automation, AI, and the balance among service quality, security, risk, and cost.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering:**  

* Lead cloud and platform services across Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, operating systems, compute, storage, backup integration, identity integration, infrastructure as code, and cloud financial management.
* Establish platform engineering standards that strengthen availability, scalability, security hardening, configuration consistency, automation, and lifecycle management.
* Oversee platform modernization, technical debt reduction, capacity planning, patching coordination, and cloud consumption governance while maintaining secure architecture and change controls.
* Ensure infrastructure configurations, privileged access, logging, and recovery capabilities support applicable security and operational requirements.

**Network & Communications:**  

* Direct enterprise and distribution center network services, including WAN, wireless, cloud connectivity, internet redundancy, DNS/DHCP, VPN, voice, and collaboration systems.
* Establish network architecture, segmentation, resilience, capacity, monitoring, and lifecycle standards for reliable and secure connectivity.
* Define engineering ownership, operational escalation, and security responsibilities for network access, perimeter protections, and business-critical network services.

**Digital Workplace, End User Services & IT Service Management:**  

* Lead digital workplace and employee technology services for office, remote, hybrid, and distribution center personnel, including endpoint engineering, mobile management, Microsoft 365, collaboration, provisioning, patching, and device lifecycle.
* Oversee service desk operations and IT service management practices across incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, and service catalog management.
* Govern endpoint security integration, asset inventory, administrative controls, secure configuration, licensing, vendor services, and secure device disposition.
* Establish measurable employee service outcomes, service levels, ownership, and continuous improvement practices across supported environments.

Site Reliability, Operational Resilience & Business Continuity:
  

* Lead monitoring and observability, service reliability engineering, incident management, root-cause analysis, backup validation, capacity management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness for critical business services.
* Establish recovery objectives, resilient designs, redundancy requirements, continuity exercises, and recovery testing aligned with critical business processes and security scenarios.
* Direct coordinated operational response to major technology availability incidents, including service restoration, escalation, stakeholder communications, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Coordinate infrastructure recovery and business continuity capabilities with information security incident response planning, including ransomware resilience and recovery testing.

**Warehouse & Distribution Center Technology Enablement:**  

* Oversee distribution center technology enablement, including warehouse wireless services, RF devices, scanners, printers, shipping workstations, local infrastructure, and site support.
* Coordinate technology dependencies for warehouse control systems, automation and conveyor interfaces, PLC connectivity, site upgrades, and peak-period readiness with Operations and vendors.
* Establish support boundaries, cybersecurity coordination, availability expectations, and escalation pathways for operational technology and warehouse infrastructure.
* Ensure appropriate business-critical recovery, segmentation, resilience, monitoring, and security controls for distribution center technology.

**Information Security Program, Architecture & Operations:**  

* Direct the enterprise information security program across FFF and applicable affiliated businesses, safeguarding confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and technology assets.
* Develop and maintain security strategy, policies, technical standards, control baselines, information classification, and security architecture aligned to enterprise operating requirements.
* Oversee security monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, endpoint and network protection, identity and privileged access security, security configuration, and remediation governance.
* Establish enterprise processes for identifying and evaluating cyber threats, reviewing emerging technologies, and embedding security into technology architecture, product development, procurement, and change management.
* Guide security capabilities and qualified internal or external specialists to provide risk-informed protection of platforms, applications, networks, sensitive information, and technology services.
* Develop security awareness and role-based training programs, promoting informed, accountable security behaviors among employees, contractors, and approved users.

**Cyber Risk, Information Protection & Third-Party Assurance:**  

* Establish and maintain the enterprise information security risk assessment process, including threat evaluation, control assessment, risk treatment tracking, and documentation of material exposures.
* Oversee cybersecurity reviews of technology suppliers and material third parties, including contractual security requirements, assessment findings, remediation commitments, and ongoing risk monitoring.
* Coordinate with business owners, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Audit on information ownership, data classification, secure handling, retention, and protection requirements.
* Report material cybersecurity risks, control deficiencies, third-party exposures, exceptions, and remediation status to designated leadership and risk governance stakeholders.
* Establish clear processes for identifying, assessing, documenting, escalating, and monitoring information security risks, ensuring material risk acceptance and independent assurance activities remain subject to established enterprise governance and designated approval authority.

**Security Policy, Regulatory Compliance & Audit:**  

* Lead development, maintenance, implementation, and communication of practical enterprise information security policies, standards, and procedures.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Internal Audit to evaluate applicable obligations and control expectations, including HIPAA, PCI DSS, CCPA/CPRA, and other relevant requirements as determined by the business.
* Coordinate security control assessments, audit evidence, remediation plans, and management responses in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit, while respecting their independent responsibilities.
* Use risk-based frameworks such as NIST and ISO 27001, where appropriate, to inform security maturity assessments, control effectiveness measures, and improvement roadmaps.
* Track security policy exceptions, audit findings, control deficiencies, and overdue remediation, and communicate material developments through established governance channels.

**Cybersecurity Incident Response & Crisis Coordination:**  

* Direct and coordinate preparedness, detection, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned during material information security incidents.
* Convene and coordinate designated security incident response resources and business stakeholders, with clear authority, severity classifications, playbooks, escalation triggers, and communication processes.
* Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, executive leadership, and external specialists on notification assessments, law enforcement engagement, evidence preservation, and crisis communications, as applicable.
* Oversee incident response exercises, technical readiness, external incident response retainers, and improvement activities following security events.
* Escalate material cybersecurity incidents promptly and coordinate technical recovery with operational continuity and established legal and crisis management processes.

**Infrastructure Architecture, Automation & Responsible AI:**  

* Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference designs, engineering practices, lifecycle planning, interoperability, and secure target-state direction.
* Advance infrastructure automation, orchestration, reusable platforms, self-service capabilities, and responsible AI-assisted operational tools with appropriate controls and human oversight.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and AI governance stakeholders to assess information protection, system access, reliability, and operational risks before new technology adoption.
* Prioritize emerging technology investments based on measurable service improvement, security outcomes, business value, operational complexity, and cost.

**Financial, Vendor & Performance Management:**  

* Own approved infrastructure and information security operating budgets, financial plans, contracts, vendor performance, resource allocations, and delivery commitments within established financial authority.
* Develop business cases and investment recommendations addressing resilience, modernization, technical debt, security maturity, regulatory exposure, and risk reduction.
* Establish integrated service and security measures for reliability, incident response, recovery, vulnerability remediation, control effectiveness, audit progress, service quality, customer experience, and cost.
* Provide regular reporting to executive leadership on service performance, material risk, financial results, investment progress, incident trends, vendor outcomes, and roadmap commitments.
* Maintain effective vendor governance for technical service levels, security obligations, incident response support, contractual performance, and required corrective actions.

**Organization, Workforce & Talent Leadership:**  

* Build and develop a high-performing combined Infrastructure Services and Information Security organization with clear functional leadership, accountability, technical expertise, and appropriate segregation of duties.
* Lead multi-year workforce and capability planning, succession, critical-role coverage, insourcing and outsourcing decisions, vendor augmentation, and targeted capability development.
* Develop leaders, managers, engineers, and security practitioners through coaching, performance management, cross-training, knowledge transfer, and career development.
* Promote a culture of engineering excellence, service ownership, proactive risk identification, ethical decision-making, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
  
  
**Required Education:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.

**Preferred Education:**  

* Advanced degree in technology leadership, cybersecurity, business administration, or related discipline.

**Required Knowledge:**  

* Enterprise infrastructure architecture and operations across public and private cloud, networking, endpoints, collaboration, identity services, and IT service management.
* Information security governance, cyber risk assessment, security architecture, threat and vulnerability management, identity and access security, incident response, and third-party assurance.
* High-availability engineering, observability, disaster recovery, business continuity, and secure technology lifecycle management.
* Recognized security and risk frameworks, security control assessment, and applicable privacy and compliance considerations, including HIPAA and other relevant regulations.
* Budgeting, vendor governance, service metrics, security performance reporting, and enterprise technology investment planning.

**Preferred Knowledge:**  

* Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, Microsoft 365, Intune, Jamf, RingCentral, Terraform, or comparable technology ecosystems.
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and security architecture or risk governance practices.
* Distribution center wireless, warehouse automation, operational technology, and high-availability transaction environments.
* Responsible AI-assisted operations, security monitoring automation, modern identity security, and cloud security practices.
* Pharmaceutical distribution, specialty healthcare services, or other regulated and business-critical operating environments.

**Required Experience:**  

* Minimum of fifteen (15) years of progressive information technology experience, including at least seven (7) years in senior technology leadership.
* Demonstrated senior-level leadership across enterprise infrastructure services and information security, including accountability for multidisciplinary technical teams, operational performance, cyber risk management, and enterprise technology initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience directing cloud, network, digital workplace, service operations, resilience, and cyber risk or information security programs in complex, distributed organizations.
* Experience directing or overseeing security incident response, risk assessments, control remediation, security assessments, and communication of material risks to executive leadership.
* Experience building and executing multi-year roadmaps, managing budgets and vendors, developing organizational capabilities, and delivering measurable technology and risk outcomes.

**Preferred Experience:**  

* Experience holding a CISO, head of information security, or comparable enterprise security leadership mandate.
* Leadership of technology services for distribution centers or other high-availability and regulated operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, SRE, modern service management, vulnerability management, and security operations maturity programs.
* Experience coordinating incident response with executive leadership, Legal, Compliance, auditors, regulators, insurers, or external response specialists as needed.
* Experience integrating infrastructure and information security functions while preserving appropriate risk escalation, independent assurance, and governance.

**Required Skills:**  

* Senior-level technology leadership with the ability to integrate infrastructure reliability, cybersecurity effectiveness, operational resilience, and disciplined resource management.
* Sound judgment during significant service and security incidents, clear escalation, crisis coordination, and concise communication to executive leadership and technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to establish organizational accountability, service ownership, effective decision rights, and appropriate segregation of duties across engineering and security functions.
* Analytical leadership using service and security measures, risk assessments, root-cause analysis, business cases, and performance reviews to inform decisions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, vendor management, negotiation, strategic planning, change leadership, and talent development skills.

**Preferred Skills:**  

* Applying security engineering and responsible AI capabilities to improve operational resilience, service quality, and control effectiveness.
* Communicating complex security exposures, incident consequences, and technology investments in business and risk terms.
* Leading integrated organization design and security program modernization within a multi-entity enterprise.

**Required Professional Certification:**  

* None required.

**Preferred Professional Certification:**  

* Relevant credentials such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CCSP, ITIL 4, Azure or Google Cloud certifications, TOGAF, PMP, or comparable infrastructure and cybersecurity qualifications.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Manager
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Manager in Doha, Qatar.**

The GSOC Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the GSOC, including but not limited to provision of guidance and supervision to other GSOC members such as GSOC Supervisor and GSOC Operator, in line with the direction set by QatarEnergy and in accordance with global standards, processes and industry best practices.

The GSOC Manager will work closely with the GSOC Supervisor and the GSOC Operator, to ensure operational planning and request management guidance are done in lockstep with ongoing and continuous intelligence assessments.

The GSOC Manager will act as enabler in the process of decision-making, in both business-as-usual and crisis scenarios, and provide required insights to support the analytical position and outlook of QatarEnergy.

The GSOC Manager will closely collaborate with the GSOC team (Supervisor and Operator) in one hand, and other departments of QatarEnergy on another, ensuring the relevant throughputs of GSOC contain an appropriate security risk assessment as part of any response and plan of action. In principle, the GSOC Manager will provide Quality Assurance check on the output of GSOC.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Oversee GSOC operational preparedness, ensuring timely security advice and clear risk assessments are provided to QatarEnergy stakeholders and business travellers.
* Provide strategic direction and oversight of GSOC request management, operational planning and service provider networks, ensuring alignment with QatarEnergy’s security outlook.
* Oversee the quality and continuous improvement of GSOC deliverables, ensuring alignment with security risk management best practices and operational requirements.
* Develop GSOC team capabilities through guidance, coaching and training in global threat monitoring, travel risk management, and crisis and emergency management.
* Collaborate with QatarEnergy stakeholders and internal departments to ensure effective query management, operational coordination and security planning.
* Maintain and enhance travel risk management resources, including hotel and security provider information, ensuring they reflect the current security environment.
* Contribute to security capability enhancement projects, including risk management training and Concept of Operations development.
* Conduct regional travel, as required, to assess security environments, evaluate local provider capabilities and strengthen security intelligence and assistance networks.
* Participate in regional security calls and support security escalations, including Crisis Updates, Crisis Management Team (CMT) briefings, and the development and execution of Plans of Action (POAs).
* Provide guidance and oversight for Executive Protection (EP) requests, leveraging vetted providers and regional expertise.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Provide strategic oversight of global threat monitoring activities and intelligence outputs, ensuring alignment with global standards and best practices.
* Guide analytical direction, validate threat assessments and integrate intelligence insights into organisational risk management and decision-making.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Oversee the delivery of travel security risk management services, ensuring alignment with client expectations and continuous intelligence assessments.
* Ensure quality assurance of travel-related security outputs, recommendations and operational planning.
* Engage with stakeholders to support the effective implementation of travel security strategies.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management**

  

* Lead GSOC operations during crises and major incidents, providing strategic direction and enabling informed decision-making.
* Oversee crisis response activities and ensure effective coordination between GSOC, internal departments and external partners.
* Approve escalation decisions and ensure appropriate communication with senior leadership.
* Maintain quality assurance across incident reporting, response actions and crisis management outputs.
* Support continuous capability development through training, mentoring and improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Extremely strong knowledge of the security risk management best practices and principals across a diversity of risk environments.
* Experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Experience in conducting profile specific security risk assessments.
* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including ability to explain complex situations and advice to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of security, logistics and threat-based information under time pressure and produce plans of action.
* Ability to identify key streams of effort and direct colleagues accordingly.
* On the ground experience in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operation.
* Strong IT skills including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, at least 8+ years’ experience in security assistance delivery and planning including deployed experience in hostile and/or challenging environments in military, NGO, government or private sector roles ideally in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Experience in planning and conducting security assistance operations.
* Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
* Experience in successfully working cross culturally.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Crisis management and Business Continuity Management experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery experience.
* Public speaking, client-facing presentation and/or media experience.
* Experience in business development and quality management

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training & experience) in a field related to security studies, war studies, international politics, international relations or similar.
* Accreditation by regionally recognised security or risk management body.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

Title: Digital Operations, Manager
Description:
At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. These individuals analyse client needs, develop operational strategies, and offer guidance and support to help clients streamline processes, improve productivity, and drive business performance. You will provide comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. Working in this area, you will analyse client needs, develop operational solutions, and offer recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.

* Engage directly with client stakeholders to align insights and solution design to decision needs and communicate results clearly.
* Work effectively across both business and technical stakeholder groups.

Title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure | USA | Remote
Description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

*This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).*

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

### **About our platform**

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

### **About the Infrastructure group**

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

### **How we work**

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
* Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
* Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
* Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
* Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
* Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
* Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
* Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
* Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
* Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
* A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
* The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
* Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
* You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
* Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

**Bonus Points For**
--------------------

* Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
* Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
* Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
* Running observability for a production platform at scale
* Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
* You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 - $227,249. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**

* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*

* Review team members' change requests, ticket documentation, and runbooks before submission or closure
* Plan coverage for leave, on-call, and after-hours change windows so that each network function has a trained backup
* Mentor and develop team members, including cross-training to reduce single points of knowledge
* Serve as the team's escalation point for technical decisions and priority conflicts

Network Engineering and Administration
  
  

* Lead the installation, configuration, and maintenance of Cisco network devices, including routers and switches
* Support integration of VMware NSX and virtual networks with the physical network, working with the virtualization team
* Provide network architecture services, including secure baseline network configurations, network implementation plans, and service deployments
* Operate and maintain wide area network (WAN) infrastructure, including dual MPLS circuits per site and high-speed interconnection between colocation facilities
* Support hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity, including Azure ExpressRoute (dual-region connectivity), AWS Direct Connect, and site-to-site redundancy architectures
* Administer network management and monitoring platforms, including PathSolutions and Cisco DNA Center, and maintain operations continuity during the transition from Cisco Prime
* Administer segmented network environments supporting operational systems
* Apply patches, updates, and security configurations to network devices across on-premises and cloud environments
* Perform or coordinate installation, replacement, structured cabling, and lifecycle management of network hardware across sites and colocation facilities

Firewall Oversight
  
  

* Direct the team's firewall work: set priorities, review changes, and track outcomes
* Maintain working knowledge of the agency's Palo Alto environment, including PAN-OS, Panorama, VPN, GlobalProtect, Prisma Access, and high availability, sufficient to assess firewall risks, plans, and changes and to cover firewall operations and incidents when needed
* Make sure firewall rule base governance, policy review, and lifecycle planning through end-of-support timelines are carried out and documented

Security and Compliance
  
  

* Work with cybersecurity on network security architecture, including segmentation, ingress/egress control, and zero-trust initiatives
* Support Trusted Internet Connections (TIC) and managed security services, including Lumen MTIPS and Cloudflare-based TIC 3.0 alignment
* Make sure network logging and telemetry, including Corelight, Garland, and SIEM integration, meet OMB M-21-31 event logging and network visibility requirements
* Provide documentation and evidence for security assessments, ATO activities, audits, and compliance reviews

Tier 3 Incident Support
  
  

* Own network Tier 3 incidents from assignment to closure, whether worked directly or assigned to a team member
* Lead troubleshooting of complex and cross-team network issues, including layer 2, layer 3, wireless, VoIP, data center, and SDN, using a structured method
* Escalate to Cisco, Palo Alto, carriers, or other vendors with a complete case record, and identify recurring incidents for permanent fixes through problem management
* Participate in and manage the network team's on-call rotation

Operations and Change Management
  
  

* Make sure the team's recurring O&M tasks are completed on schedule and recorded in ServiceNow
* Follow the NCUA change management process and hold the team to it: submit change requests with scope, risk, test, implementation, and rollback plans
* Validate network and firewall changes through change windows, failover scenarios, and DR exercises

Projects
  
  

* Lead network projects from planning through closeout, including scope, requirements, milestones and dependencies, stakeholder agreement, phased implementation with rollback planning, and user communications
* Support telecommunications and transition initiatives
* Research emerging network technologies and report on how they provide value to the agency

Communication and Documentation
  
  

* Communicate directly with end users, government stakeholders, and contract counterparts: explain issues and impact in plain language, set expectations on timelines, and confirm outcomes
* Make sure ticket notes and work logs are written in ServiceNow as work happens, so another engineer can pick up the issue without re-contacting the user
* Maintain network documentation, including configurations, diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, and configuration management artifacts, and update it after incidents, changes, and projects

**Required Skills:**

* 10+ years of enterprise network engineering and administration experience, including 5+ years leading technical teams, with direct responsibility for assigning, tracking, and reviewing the work of other engineers
* Strong experience with Cisco routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, layer 2 and layer 3), WAN and data center connectivity including MPLS, and hybrid cloud connectivity (Azure ExpressRoute or AWS Direct Connect)
* Working knowledge of Palo Alto firewalls (PAN-OS, Panorama, VPN and GlobalProtect) sufficient to direct firewall work and provide backup coverage
* Experience planning and tracking team work in Azure DevOps or a similar agile tool, including backlog management, sprint planning, and status reporting
* Demonstrated experience resolving Tier 3 network incidents in a ticketed (ITSM) environment, using a repeatable troubleshooting process
* Demonstrated experience following a formal change management process (change requests, change board review, implementation and rollback plans)
* Demonstrated experience planning and delivering network projects through closeout
* Experience working directly with end users and government or customer stakeholders, verbally and in writing
* Ability to support critical issues and incidents after hours as needed
* Ability to maintain a Public Trust security clearance

**Education Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent
* VMware networking certification, such as VCP-NV
* Palo Alto Networks certification, such as Next-Generation Firewall Engineer, Network Security Analyst, PCNSE, or PCNSA
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent IT service management training
* Experience supporting VMware NSX or similar network virtualization from the physical network side (strongly preferred)
* Experience with ServiceNow, Azure DevOps (ADO), PathSolutions, and Cisco DNA Center
* Familiarity with federal networking and security requirements (e.g., TIC 3.0, MTIPS, OMB M-21-31) and ATO support
* Prior experience supporting a federal agency

**Soft Skills:**

* Leadership and Delegation: Assigns work with clear expectations, follows up on progress, and holds the team to agreed timelines and quality

Title: Incident Operations Manager
Description:
**About This Role**
At Chime, we help our members achieve financial peace of mind. To do this we need features that are highly available and human & technical systems that are resilient. That’s where you come in. You will be a member of our Incident Response team to help Chime improve our readiness, response and drive organizational change from incidents.
  
  
As an Incident Operations Manager on Chime's Incident Operations team (Platform Engineering), you'll manage incidents end to end: from declaration and coordination, through member communication and member remediation, to review and follow-through. You'll work across Engineering, Product, Member Experience (MX), Core Experience, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, and lead through influence rather than authority. You'll bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and keep the member at the center of every decision. Alongside on-call work, you'll own defined improvement workstreams that make our response better every quarter.
  
  
**In This Role, You Can Expect To**

* Coordinate incidents end to end. Serve on the incident on-call rotation, including some after-hours coverage on weekends, nights, and holidays. Independently run incidents from declaration to resolution: setting severity, paging the right responders, running the bridge, confirming member impact, and driving mitigation decisions.
* Help drive communication during incidents. Draft clear, accurate member messages across in-app, push, inbox, email, and support channels; move them through Compliance and Legal approval within severity-based timelines; and keep Support and MX teams equipped with talking points.
* Drive member remediation to closure. Run the Remediating phase: define workstreams, DRIs, and exit criteria; partner with Data to size the impacted population; coordinate credits and bulk adjustments with Finance, Compliance, and Core Experience
* Keep stakeholders informed. Deliver timely status reports and sitreps for leadership, and supply impact summaries and timelines that Compliance and Legal use for bank partner and regulatory notifications.
* Close the loop. Facilitate incident reviews for the incidents you manage, capture learnings, and make sure corrective actions have owners and due dates.
* Get ahead of problems. Spot risks and gaps before they become incidents or repeat incidents, raise them early, and come up with a proposed solution.
* Improve how we respond. Own at least one program workstream, such as pre-approved member message templates, runbooks, or response metrics, and ship measurable improvements.
* Cross-train and share knowledge. Build working fluency on both the technical-command and member-impact sides of an incident, and help train coordinators and responders.

**To thrive in this role, you have**

* 3+ years in incident management, or a similar operational role, including hands-on coordination of live, customer-impacting incidents.
* A strong member focus. You think first about how an incident affects real people and their money, and you measure success by whether members are informed and made whole, not just whether systems are restored.
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach. You act before being asked, look for the next risk instead of waiting for it, and bring options and recommendations.
* Experience managing the customer side of an incident: writing customer-facing communications, working with support teams, and coordinating remediation.
* Calm, structured judgment under pressure; you know when to decide, when to escalate, and when to ask for help.
* Enough technical fluency to follow engineers through an investigation and ask good questions (observability, deploys, dependencies, distributed systems).
* Experience with incident and observability tools such as PagerDuty, incident.io, Datadog, Slack-based incident tooling, Jira, and Google Workspace.
* Clear, concise writing for different audiences: members, technical SMEs, compliance partners, and executives.
* Strong follow-through; you drive action items and remediation work to closure without being chased.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another regulated industry.

The Major Incident Manager coordinates and manages responses to major IT incidents to minimize business disruption and restore services as quickly as possible. This role serves as the central coordination point throughout the major incident lifecycle, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, managing escalations, coordinating technical teams, and ensuring timely stakeholder communications. Responsibilities also include supporting Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs), collaborating on Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and tracking follow-up actions. * PPO medical plan, available day one at no cost for full-time employee-only coverage
* 100% coverage for preventive healthcare-no copay
* Paid Time Off, available day one
* Retirement Programs through the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS)
* Paid Parental Leave Benefit
* Wellness programs
* Tuition Reimbursement

**Required Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Required Experience**

* **Five or more years of experience in IT Service Management, Incident Management, IT Operations, or a related IT service delivery function.**
* **A minimum of 5 year’s experience as a Major Incident Manager with experience coordinating and leading high-impact incidents, escalations, or cross-functional IT operational activities.**
* Working knowledge of Incident Management and Major Incident Management practices.
* Experience using ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident Management and related workflows.
* Strong understanding of incident prioritization, impact assessment, escalation procedures, and service restoration activities.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple technical teams and stakeholders during time-sensitive situations.
Experience with Post-Incident Reviews, Problem Management, and Root Cause Analysis is preferred.  

**Preffered Experience**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences and leadership.
* Strong facilitation, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain composed, exercise sound judgment, and manage competing priorities in high-pressure situations.
* Demonstrated accountability, attention to detail, and ability to maintain accurate incident documentation and timelines.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across organizational boundaries.
ITIL 4 Foundation certification preferred; ITIL v5 certification or relevant ITSM training is a plus.  

**Work Schedule & Availability**
  
This is a temporary to permanent, full-time position. While the position will generally operate during standard business hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday work will be required periodically to support major incident response, service restoration, and operational coverage. Flexibility and availability outside of normal business hours are essential requirements of this position.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assess incident impact and urgency, validate escalation criteria, and facilitate appropriate major incident designation.
* Serve as the central coordination point for major incident response activities across technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage major incident bridges, ensuring appropriate participation, structure, and progress.

* Facilitate prioritization, escalation, and resource coordination to support timely service restoration.
* Ensure incident records, timelines, decisions, actions, and status updates are accurately maintained in ServiceNow.
* Coordinate timely and consistent communications with IT leadership, business stakeholders, affected departments, and other impacted audiences.
* Partner with Major Incident Process Owner and Communications Managers to ensure communications are accurate, appropriate, and delivered according to established standards.
* Monitor incident progress and provide status updates, escalation notifications, and executive summaries as appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate handoffs between Major Incident Management, Incident Management, and Problem Management.
* Participate in and facilitate post-incident reviews (PIRs), documenting lessons learned, response effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with the Problem Manager on root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
* Ensure outstanding action items and follow-up activities are documented, assigned, and tracked through completion.
* Maintain adherence to established ITIL practices, operational procedures, escalation guidelines, and communication standards.
* Support continual improvement by identifying recurring challenges, process gaps, and opportunities to improve major incident response.
* Provide operational support outside of standard business hours, including overnight, weekends, and holidays as required.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

* Work requires ability to ensure adherence to all policies and procedures of university.
* Work requires ability to work with confidential information on a daily basis.
* Work requires ability to effectively interpret and apply organizational policies, procedures, and systems.

**Brief Job Description**
**This position is open to U.S. Citizens and permanent residents.**
**This onsite role requires the selected candidate to work from an HHS office in Austin, Texas.**
Under the general supervision of the Public Health Applications Infectious Disease Prevention (IDP) Director, provides leadership and supervision essential to ensuring efficient and effective application delivery and operational excellence for the Portfolio. Supervises the staff within this group to ensure effective delivery and ongoing support of Information Technology (IT) services to customers. Oversees and/or manages projects that implement solutions for customers in this area. Works closely with customers to help determine customer needs and priorities. Plans projects and individual work assignments to implement solutions to those needs and to ensure that priorities are met. Responsible for ensuring up time and keeping critical systems up and running. Responsible for ensuring correct operation of application software within this area. Works with other members of the IT Section to develop, deploy, and continuously improve common software development and maintenance practices and procedures. Uses Service Delivery Plan process and maintains quarterly work plans, including scheduling, resources allocation, and estimates. Ensures compliance with Department and State Human Resource (HR) policy and work rules. Ensures compliance with Department and State automation policy and plans. Ensures compliance with Department and State guidance on automation system architecture. This position is classified as a full-time position (40 hours a week). Work outside of regular hours and being on call may be required. Travel to other work locations may be required. Performs other duties as assigned
  
  
**Essential Job Functions (EJFs)**
Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.
  
  
EJF 1. Provides leadership and supervision essential to ensuring efficient and effective operational readiness for DSHS customers. Supervises the overall planning, implementation, coordination, and evaluation of services in the assigned IT Public Health infectious Disease Prevention portfolio. Responsibilities include meeting established goals, ensuring SOPs, documentation and on call schedules are in place and properly followed, organizing the work-based priority and overseeing day-to-day operations so that activities are completed on time. Supervises project managers/team leaders or highly complex projects that require coordinating, planning, and scheduling during project development and implementation stages. Supervises and oversees day-to-day operations so that SLAs are met, ITSM tickets are addressed, and monitoring and alerting are in place for critical systems. Liaise with Managed Service Providers. Security & Governance: Maintain vendor and app management, and security requirements. Enforce security policies and contribute to cross-functional security related strategy and execution. (50%)
  
  
EJF 2. Assists Director with HHS System consolidation. Assists with research and contract management for using outsourced services, including the development of RFP’s, the evaluation of bids, and provides recommendations. Assists with vendor management and provides performance reporting. Assists Director with the consolidation of services to achieve cost reductions and / or improved services. (20%)
  
  
EJF 3. Advises, consults and negotiates with DSHS customers in providing software development services for and evaluating service level performance consistent with DSHS, HHSC and DIR plans, standards and guidelines. Provides leadership to assigned managers and staff to ensure services are coordinated, efficient, follow best practices and policies, and meet service level objectives. Maintains up-to-date knowledge of other branches within the DSHS Applications Development Unit and negotiates sharing of resources to achieve objectives across the Section. (10%)
  
  
EJF 4. Manages and develops staff through review of performance data, consultation, training and performance appraisal. Responsible for hiring and selection, assigning work, completing performance evaluations, recommending personnel disciplinary actions, and scheduling and approving leave. (5%)
  
  
EJF 5. Assures IDP portfolio conforms to and complies with all related policies, standards, procedures, activities, and required reports provided by the section, DSHS, HHSC, and oversight agencies. Assures project managers conform to and comply with all related policies, standards, procedures, activities, and that required reports are provided to DSHS, HHSC and oversight agencies. (5%)
  
  
EJF 6. Provides input to Director on budget development, staff allocations, and recommendations for effective and efficient use of resources. (5%)
  
  
EJF 7. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location. (5%)
